# xxHash (vendored)

- **Version:** 0.8.3
- **License:** BSD-2-Clause (see `LICENSE`)
- **Source:** https://github.com/Cyan4973/xxHash
- **Files:** `xxhash.h`, `xxh3.h` — vendored unmodified.

Used by `StreamLine::Containers::CMap` for XXH3-128 hashing. Vendored
(not pulled via vcpkg) to keep Streamline a zero-external-dependency library.
